channel.title: UPSC NCERT Audiobooks — Maargapp
channel.description:
Complete chapter-by-chapter audiobooks of Class 6 to 12 NCERTs for UPSC Civil Services Examination (IAS / IPS / IFS) aspirants, produced by Maargapp. Season 1 covers Class 11 Political Science: Indian Constitution at Work. Broadcast-grade narration with warmth equalization and ACX loudness compliance for deep conceptual understanding and daily revision on the go.
Educational Fair Use Notice: Produced under Section 52 of the Indian Copyright Act for educational study. Content sourced from NCERT curriculum. Maargapp is an independent educational brand.
channel.itunes:author: Maargapp

item.title: Class 11 Polity • Ch 01: Constitution — Why and How?
item.description: Chapter 1 of NCERT Class 11 Political Science: Indian Constitution at Work. Complete audio narration of 'Constitution: Why and How?'. Explores why societies need constitutions, the making of the Indian Constitution, Constituent Assembly debates, and key institutional arrangements. Narrated for UPSC CSE (IAS/IPS/IFS) aspirants with ACX broadcast clarity.

item.title: Class 11 Polity • Ch 02: Rights in the Indian Constitution
item.description: Chapter 2 of NCERT Class 11 Political Science: Indian Constitution at Work. Complete audio narration of 'Rights in the Indian Constitution'. In-depth analysis of Fundamental Rights (Articles 12 to 35), Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP), Fundamental Duties, and National Human Rights Commission (NHRC). Mastered for UPSC CSE.

item.title: Class 11 Polity • Ch 03: Election and Representation
item.description: Chapter 3 of NCERT Class 11 Political Science: Indian Constitution at Work. Complete audio narration of 'Election and Representation'. Contrasts First Past the Post (FPTP) with Proportional Representation (PR), powers of the Election Commission of India (ECI), electoral reforms, and reserved constituencies. Mastered for UPSC CSE.

item.title: Class 11 Polity • Ch 04: Executive
item.description: Chapter 4 of NCERT Class 11 Political Science: Indian Constitution at Work. Complete audio narration of 'Executive'. Covers the Parliamentary Executive in India, powers and constitutional role of the President, Prime Minister, Council of Ministers, and the Permanent Civil Services. Mastered for UPSC CSE.

item.title: Class 11 Polity • Ch 05: Legislature
item.description: Chapter 5 of NCERT Class 11 Political Science: Indian Constitution at Work. Complete audio narration of 'Legislature'. Examines bicameralism, Lok Sabha vs Rajya Sabha, legislative procedure (how bills become laws), parliamentary oversight mechanisms, and standing committees. Mastered for UPSC CSE.

item.title: Class 11 Polity • Ch 06: Judiciary
item.description: Chapter 6 of NCERT Class 11 Political Science: Indian Constitution at Work. Complete audio narration of 'Judiciary'. Details judicial independence, appointment procedures (Collegium system), Supreme Court jurisdictions (Original, Appellate, Advisory, Writs), Judicial Activism, and Public Interest Litigation (PIL). Mastered for UPSC CSE.

item.title: Class 11 Polity • Ch 07: Federalism
item.description: Chapter 7 of NCERT Class 11 Political Science: Indian Constitution at Work. Complete audio narration of 'Federalism'. Explores Indian federal principles, division of powers (Union, State, Concurrent lists), Centre-State dynamics, role of Governors, President's Rule (Article 356), and interstate coordination. Mastered for UPSC CSE.

item.title: Class 11 Polity • Ch 08: Local Governments
item.description: Chapter 8 of NCERT Class 11 Political Science: Indian Constitution at Work. Complete audio narration of 'Local Governments'. Detailed breakdown of democratic decentralisation, the 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendment Acts, Panchayati Raj institutions, and urban local bodies. Mastered for UPSC CSE.

item.title: Class 11 Polity • Ch 09: Constitution as a Living Document
item.description: Chapter 9 of NCERT Class 11 Political Science: Indian Constitution at Work. Complete audio narration of 'Constitution as a Living Document'. Analyzes the amendment procedure under Article 368, judicial interpretations, the Basic Structure doctrine, and the landmark Kesavananda Bharati ruling. Mastered for UPSC CSE.

item.title: Class 11 Polity • Ch 10: The Philosophy of the Constitution
item.description: Chapter 10 of NCERT Class 11 Political Science: Indian Constitution at Work. Complete audio narration of 'The Philosophy of the Constitution'. Explores political morality, individual freedom, social justice, Indian secularism, universal adult franchise, national identity, and procedural achievements. Mastered for UPSC CSE.
